observations: Photo 0: silver and black retro style mirrorless camera body with a Nikon Z mount body cap; badges read 'Nikon' on the prism and 'Z fc' on the top plate; dealer watermark 'OYIBEST GLOBAL RESOURCES'.
Photo 1: the same body fitted with a small black manual focus lens with a distance scale and aperture ring; 'TTArtisan' is partly legible on the lens barrel; ISO dial and 'Z fc' badge visible.

Photo 2: top view of the camera with the lens fitted, a Nikon branded rechargeable battery, a Nikon battery charger, a Nikon body cap, a rear lens cap, and a front lens cap reading 'TTArtisan APS-C 25mm F2.0'.
Bodywork looks clean with no visible dents or heavy scratches; the rear screen is never shown and the camera is never shown powered on.
Photos are studio style shots on a plain background with a dealer watermark.
